description: Add or remove a host to Icinga2 through the API.

parameters.name: check_command
parameters.description: The command used to check if the host is alive. Default: "hostalive"

parameters.name: client_cert
parameters.description: PEM formatted certificate chain file to be used for SSL client authentication. This file can also include the key as well, and if the key is included, client_key is not required.

parameters.name: client_key
parameters.description: PEM formatted file that contains your private key to be used for SSL client authentication. If client_cert contains both the certificate and key, this option is not required.

parameters.name: display_name
parameters.description: The name used to display the host. If not specified, it defaults to the value of the name parameter.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: If yes do not get a cached copy. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: force_basic_auth
parameters.description: httplib2, the library used by Ansible’s HTTP request code only sends authentication information when a webservice responds to an initial request with a 401 status. Since some basic auth services do not properly send a 401, logins may fail. This option forces the sending of the Basic authentication header upon initial request. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: http_agent
parameters.description: Header to identify as, generally appears in web server logs. Default: "ansible-httpget"

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: The IP address of the host. This is no longer required since community.general 8.0.0.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name used to create / delete the host. This does not need to be the FQDN, but does needs to be unique.

parameters.name: template
parameters.description: The template used to define the host. Template cannot be modified after object creation.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: HTTP, HTTPS, or FTP URL in the form (http|https|ftp)://[user[:pass]]@host.domain[:port]/path.

parameters.name: url_password
parameters.description: The password for use in HTTP basic authentication. If the url_username parameter is not specified, the url_password parameter is not used.

parameters.name: url_username
parameters.description: The username for use in HTTP basic authentication. This parameter can be used without url_password for sites that allow empty passwords.

parameters.name: use_gssapi
parameters.description: Use GSSAPI to perform the authentication, typically this is for Kerberos or Kerberos through Negotiate authentication. Requires the Python library gssapi to be installed. Credentials for GSSAPI can be specified with url_username/url_password or with the GSSAPI env var KRB5CCNAME that specified a custom Kerberos credential cache. NTLM authentication is not supported even if the GSSAPI mech for NTLM has been installed. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: use_proxy
parameters.description: If false, it does not use a proxy, even if one is defined in an environment variable on the target hosts. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: If false, SSL certificates are not validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: zone
parameters.description: The zone from where this host should be polled.

examples:
- name: Add host to icinga
  community.general.icinga2_host:
    url: "https://icinga2.example.com"
    url_username: "ansible"
    url_password: "a_secret"
    state: present
    name: "{{ ansible_fqdn }}"
    ip: "{{ ansible_default_ipv4.address }}"
    variables:
      foo: "bar"
  delegate_to: 127.0.0.1

return_values.name: data
return_values.description: The data structure used for create, modify or delete of the host. Returned: always

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: The name used to create, modify or delete the host. Returned: always
